text.ko: 업종 내 매우 우수. 강점: 자기자본이익률(ROE) 289.7%.

text.en: Strong within its sector. Strength: Revenue growth consistency 100%.

text.en: Weak within its sector. Strength: Asset age (accumulated depreciation share) 54.5%. Weakness: Liabilities to equity 929.1%.

text.ko: 현재 경제 환경이 이 업종에 유리한 편이에요. 주요 요인: 금리 상승 국면 (유리).
text.en: The current economy tends to favor this sector. Main factor: rising rates (helps).
